_about: The About footprint map and the working-hours strip. Operating markers sit on the centroid of their countries, not on a city, so the map never implies an office. The delivery marker is Lahore itself. The strip is built but not rendered until `showOverlap` is true: the hours below are standard office hours, not the delivery team's real hours.

markers.label: GCC
markers._note: Bahrain is below Natural Earth 110m resolution and cannot be placed; its weight on this centroid would be negligible.

overlap.title: Working hours, UTC
overlap._note: Standard time, no daylight saving. GCC at UTC+4 (UAE and Oman); Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain are UTC+3. `delivery` marks the row every other row's overlap is measured against.
